record_type_quote: This replication study quantified magnetophosphene perception thresholds in 62 healthy participants exposed to sinusoidal magnetic fields (0–50 mT) at 20, 50, and 60 Hz.

targets.title: Thresholds and mechanisms of human magnetophosphene perception induced by low frequency sinusoidal magnetic fields.
targets.evidence_quote: This study replicated the main findings of Legros et al. (2024) 5 regarding magnetophosphene induction by ELF-MF delivered through tAMS.
targets.outcome_quote: Overall, the replication provides strong evidence that tAMS reliably evokes magnetophosphenes through retinal mechanisms, confirms the robustness of threshold patterns across frequencies and exposure sites, and further supports the use of tAMS as a reproducible tool for studying human sensitivity to ELF-MF.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors give an overall successful replication verdict. The isolated higher retinal 50 Hz estimate does not change their overall interpretation.
